messages:
Asha Patel: Heads-up — mossy puddle apocalypse at Moss Ln & 7th. Bus shelter is basically a wading pool. 22/7 detours, saw the driver wave people down onto Maple. Anyone near that stop?
CommuteBot: Transit alert: Route 22 and 7 are running on a temporary detour due to flooding at Moss Ln & 7th. Expect ~10-20 min delays. More info: https://sf-transit.example/alerts/2345
Tom Reynolds: wow. ran through that on my bike this morning, shoes ruined. :grimacing:
Priya Gupta: Ugh. Caltrain was fine for me but I had to walk the last 8 mins because the 7 skipped the stop. Is there a safe dry spot to wait?
Elliot Chen: There's a tiny alcove by the bakery on the corner — I stood there for 5 min. If anyone needs a pair of spare socks I have one in my bag (not glamorous). :sweat_smile:
Asha Patel: @Elliot hero. Can you drop them at the 9:30 shuttle so I don't have soggy socks all day? :pray:
Tom Reynolds: quick poll — who wants a rescue umbrella run from Mission? React with :umbrella: if yes.
Priya Gupta: :umbrella: (please)
Elliot Chen: I can swing by on my way to the office in 20. Drop a pinned msg with exact stop?
Asha Patel: Moss Ln & 7th, bus shelter alcove by Bluebird Bakery. Thank you!
CommuteBot: Update: power flicker reported near Adeline & 12th, some streetlights out. Use caution crossing.
Tom Reynolds: PSA — if you're walking 7th, watch for crushed glass near the curb. I nearly stepped on it.
Priya Gupta: Thanks for the heads-up. Also, any word on when the 22 will resume normal routing?
CommuteBot: Route 22 detour expected to remain until city crews clear the blocked drain. Estimated time to normal routing: ~2 hours.
Elliot Chen: If anyone needs dry shoes, I can leave them on the bench by the bakery. Please DM me so I don't accidentally take someone's lunch.
Asha Patel: Appreciate it. Also — tiny soggy dog spotted under the shelter, very offended. :dog:
Tom Reynolds: Someone get a picture for the pet account? :joy:
Priya Gupta: Heading that way now to grab socks. Will update if 22 starts stopping again.
Asha Patel: Thanks all, stay dry and watch the glass :)
